tools.name: jisr_list_employees
tools.description: List the organization's employees (active by default) with code, names (English/Arabic), job title, department, business unit, employment type, line manager, joining date and status. Filter by active/inactive status, creation date and joining, termination or deletion date ranges. If the API key also

tools.name: jisr_get_employee
tools.description: One employee's profile by id (UUID from jisr_list_employees): names, code, gender, marital status, phone, emails, date of birth, passport/ID number, address, line manager, department, business unit, employment type, location, nationality and contract. GET /openapi/v1/employees/basic_info?id=.

tools.name: jisr_get_employee_financial_info
tools.description: One employee's financial details by id: salary components and bank account (IBAN). Sensitive payroll data; needs the 'Get Employee Financial Info' permission on the API key. GET /openapi/v1/employees/financial_info?id=.

tools.name: jisr_list_lookup
tools.description: List one of the organization's lookup tables: departments, employment_types, business_units, locations, nationalities or outsourcing_companies, with their ids and English/Arabic names. Use the ids when creating an employee. GET /openapi/v1/lookups/{table}.

tools.name: jisr_list_attendance_summary
tools.description: Attendance summary per employee for a date range (default: the current month): total working hours, late arrival, early departure, extra and approved overtime, absence days and records. Filter by one employee or by active/inactive status. GET /openapi/v1/attendance/summary.

tools.name: jisr_list_attendance_punches
tools.description: List raw clock-in/out punches that were received from punch devices, either the ones that were processed successfully or the ones that failed, in a time window (Jisr's default: the last hour). Each punch has id, punch_time, employee_code, terminal_sn and clocking_id. GET /openapi/v1/attendance_logs.

tools.name: jisr_get_annual_leave_balances
tools.description: Annual leave balance summaries per employee (all employees, or only the given employee codes, at most 100). Only the annual leave type is supported by Jisr. GET /openapi/v1/employee_leaves/summary.

tools.name: jisr_list_paygroups
tools.description: List the organization's pay groups (id and name). The pay group id is needed for payroll and accrual queries. GET /openapi/v1/paygroups.

tools.name: jisr_list_payroll_transactions
tools.description: Payroll transactions per employee for one settlement type. type 'payrun' (the regular payroll) needs pay_period and paygroup_id; 'final_settlements', 'vacations_settlements' and 'out_off_payroll_transactions' need a from/to date range. Optionally filter by employee ids or transaction type ids (jisr_

tools.name: jisr_list_accrual_transactions
tools.description: Accruals per employee for a confirmed pay period: vacations, end_of_service or tickets_provision (amount, vacation days). Sensitive payroll data. GET /openapi/v1/accrual_transactions.

tools.name: jisr_get_employee_monthly_payables
tools.description: One employee's payables for a month: net salary, earnings, additions and deductions with breakdowns. Only available to organizations Jisr has whitelisted for this API. Sensitive payroll data. GET /openapi/v1/employee_monthly_payables.

tools.name: jisr_list_gl_transaction_types
tools.description: List the payroll (GL) transaction types: id, category (allowances, loan types...), English/Arabic name and status. Use the ids to filter jisr_list_payroll_transactions. GET /openapi/v1/gl_transaction_types.

tools.name: jisr_list_audit_events
tools.description: The organization's audit trail: who did what and when (module, feature, action, actor, success). Filter by module, event name, event type and a time range. GET /openapi/v1/audit_events.

tools.name: jisr_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks registered for the organization: name, endpoint host, method, status. Authentication data, custom header values and the endpoint's path and query (they can hold secrets) are hidden. Read-only; this server does not create or change webhooks. GET /openapi/v1/webhooks.

tools.name: jisr_create_employee
tools.description: WRITE: register a new employee in Jisr (they are invited to the system by email). Not reversible through this server: there is no delete tool. Get department_id, employment_type_id, location_id and nationality_id from jisr_list_lookup first. Names need at least two parts. POST /openapi/v1/employees.

tools.name: jisr_create_attendance_punches
tools.description: WRITE: send a batch of raw clock-in/out punches (at most 100) from a punch device into Jisr attendance. Jisr processes them asynchronously; check the result with jisr_list_attendance_punches. Each punch carries the unique id its device generated; do not invent ids. POST /openapi/v1/attendance_logs.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "jisr_list_webhooks" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "jisr_create_employee" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: code, full_name_en, full_name_ar, email, personal_email, gender, marital_status, joining_date, document_number, nationality_id, department_id, employment_type_id, location_id, outsourcing_company_id, contract_type, contract_period, contract_end_date

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: jisr_get_employee, jisr_create_employee, jisr_create_attendance_punches · Private data: jisr_list_employees, jisr_get_employee_financial_info, jisr_list_attendance_summary, jisr_list_webhooks · Public sink: jisr_create_employee, jisr_create_attendance_punches · Destructive: jisr_create_employee.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: jisr_get_employee, jisr_create_employee, jisr_create_attendance_punches · Private data: jisr_list_employees, jisr_get_employee_financial_info, jisr_list_attendance_summary, jisr_list_webhooks · Public sink: jisr_create_employee, jisr_create_attendance_punches · Destructive: jisr_create_employee

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
